text: {"findings":[{"title":"Large Historical Crash Drawdown","why_it_matters":"A replay of the 2008–09 financial crisis using today’s portfolio weights shows a maximum drawdown of $264,672, with proxies used for some holdings.","fact_keys":["crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_usd","crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_pct","crash_replays[0].proxies"],"dollar_fact_key":"crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_usd"},{"title":"Retirement Income Gap","why_it_matters":"The retirement plan’s target nest egg exceeds the counted balance by $217,004, and projected supported income is below the stated income goal.","fact_keys":["retirement_plan.scenarios[0].gap_usd","retirement_plan.scenarios[0].supported_income_usd","retirement_plan.target_nest_egg_usd","retirement_plan.counted_balance_usd","retirement_plan.income_needed_from_portfolio_usd"],"dollar_fact_key":"retirement_plan.scenarios[0].gap_usd"},{"title":"Long-Term Fees Above Baseline","why_it_matters":"Projected fees over 30 years are $151,094 above the stated baseline, with GFACX accounting for most of the current annual fees.","fact_keys":["fees.projection[2].extra_vs_baseline_usd","fees.projection[2].fees_cost_usd","fees.costliest_funds[0].annual_usd","fees.costliest_funds[0].expense_ratio_pct"],"dollar_fact_key":"fees.projection[2].extra_vs_baseline_usd"}]}
